data.desc: LogProstyle Inc. is involved in a wide range of businesses, including real estate development, hotel management, and restaurant management. With the slogan 'redefine life style', the Company is working on various projects with the aim of illustrating an innovative and sustainable lifestyle. LogProstyle is the first unlisted Japanese company to list its Japanese common shares directly on a major United States stock exchange rather than through American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
